title: Baseline current SQLite schema as 0001_initial.sql
description:
Convert the current intended SQLite schema into the new baseline migration.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add 0001_initial.sql containing the current intended schema.
- Preserve all tables, indexes, constraints, and default/bootstrap assumptions from the current schema.
- Empty DB initialization through the new runner produces a working DB equivalent to the current fresh initialization behavior.
- Do not reconstruct historical schema versions unless needed for the chosen legacy adoption path.
close_reason: 0001_initial.sql baseline landed in PR #316 (merged). Encodes current v15 schema + seed rows; proven structurally equivalent to initSchema for fresh init.
